Windows release contract

The visible application name is PMA Mic Bridge. Package filenames, executable
name, installation ID and settings paths stay stable for existing installations.

1. Change Version in ApolloMicBridge.csproj, then run build.ps1. The script
   runs audio/settings/updater checks and builds the setup and portable ZIP.
   Its AppVersion argument keeps the setup version aligned with the application.
2. Create a GitHub Release in LeCyreaxYT/fivem-mic-distortion-fix with a matching
   tag, for example 0.2.0 or v0.2.0. Both stable releases and published
   prereleases are eligible. Drafts are ignored. Use increasing numeric versions;
   semver preview tags such as v0.3.0-beta.1 are supported.
3. Attach both complete packages before publishing:
   ApolloMicBridge-Setup-<version>.exe
   ApolloMicBridge-Portable-win-x64.zip
   Keep the portable ZIP's three root files unchanged: ApolloMicBridge.exe,
   LICENSE and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt. GitHub provides the SHA-256 asset digest.

The app checks the 100 most recent published releases once per launch and on
request. It chooses the highest version above its assembly version. Missing
assets, missing checksums and network/rate-limit failures are shown separately
from the audio status. There is no GitHub token in the application.

Installing an offered update downloads and verifies the package first, then
stops audio, saves its settings and starts a separate copy of the application
to perform the update. Setup installations use their existing per-user path;
portable installations replace only their three package files and roll back on
replacement failure. The updater restarts the app and resumes a previously
running microphone route. Autostart registration and settings are preserved.

The helper and installer log are retained in the application's local Update
directory and reused on the next update. Downloads and portable backups are
removed after success. A failed portable rollback retains its backup for recovery.

Versions before 0.2.0 do not have an updater. Install 0.2.0 once manually to
receive subsequent releases through the app.
